phase: Accounting Spine / F4 BNR zero-liability structural adjudication
purpose: Adjudicate whether the previously conditional stock-only BNR zero-liability partition may be promoted to an exact structural constraint under ESA 2010 financial-balance-sheet semantics, without extending the result to transactions or allocating the BNR asset row.

retained_empirical_condition.condition: BNR total non-consolidated F4 liability stock is exactly zero throughout the retained 2025 boundary.

official_methodological_evidence.finding: Loans arise when creditors lend to debtors and constitute an unconditional debt to the creditor that must be repaid.

Non-negotiable financial instruments are recorded at nominal value and counterpart financial assets and liabilities carry the same balance-sheet value; loans are recorded at nominal value for both creditors and debtors, including non-performing loans.

A non-consolidated financial balance sheet shows all financial assets and liabilities of units in the sector, including positions whose counterparty is within the same sector; the debtor/creditor balance sheet is a breakdown of financial assets by debtor sector and liabilities by creditor sector.

Financial transactions are recorded net of acquisitions/disposals or incurrence/repayment within an instrument category; therefore a zero transaction total does not imply zero bilateral transaction components.
The retained BNR F4 liability stock control is a non-consolidated closing-balance-sheet position using ESA-standard valuation.

structural_argument.stock_partition_rule: For the non-consolidated debtor/creditor balance sheet, total BNR F4 liabilities are partitioned by creditor sector. Each bilateral F4 stock liability is the nominal amount of an outstanding debt claim and is therefore non-negative within the F4 liability classification.
structural_argument.implication: If the complete non-consolidated BNR F4 liability stock equals zero, every bilateral holder→BNR F4 stock position in that partition must equal zero.

adjudication.remaining_stock_boundary: The BNR-holder F4 asset row remains 6.1 million RON in aggregate but its five counterpart allocations H/C/F/G/X remain unidentified; paired F-holder cells move through the exact S12=F+BNR identity.
